book_name: 四川钝颚白蚊 Ahmaditermes sichuanensis
en: The original account preserves only the name and a single locality record for this species; no description of the soldier, the alate or the worker survives in the source. The entry therefore gives the distribution alone, Sichuan at Hejiang, and no caste diagnosis can be offered. Material from the type region will be needed before the soldier and alate can be characterised and compared with congeners of the genus.
